name: Sonobuoy drop reservation
summary: Schedule movement to specified positions and sonobuoy drops. A proposal can use multiple units and drop positions.
requirements: Requires Data for AI access to own units and weapons. The target must be a player-controlled unit with available sonobuoys. Aircraft must be airborne. Orders are appended to existing reservations, using the current in-game depth setting.
proposal_append: Existing reservations will be preserved. The current in-game depth setting will be used.
